t: Who is kept away from the fire
a: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
p: Wa sa-yujannabuha-l-atqā, alladhī yu'tī mālahu yatazakkā, wa mā li-aḥadin ʿindahu min niʿmatin tujzā.
m: But the righteous one will avoid it [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
